title: Unimodal Shortcuts and Joint Scene-Intent Dependence in Vision-Language Safety Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.27339v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The safety of a request to a vision-language model often depends on the image: asking how to serve a dish is harmless for fresh food and harmful for spoiled food. High accuracy on situational safety benchmarks does not tell us whether a model's safety representation encodes both the scene and the user's intent, because a benchmark can often be solved from one modality alone. Studying frozen vision-language safety representations, we audit five public situational benchmarks and find that each admits a unimodal shortcut: images alone predict the labels, and on same-image prompt pairs a probe that never sees the photograph reaches 0.9645 AUROC. We therefore build a controlled evaluation that crosses safe and hazardous scenes with observation and action requests, so that no single-modality rule can exceed 0.500 group-ranking accuracy. On this control, linear probes on intermediate states of Qwen3-VL-8B and SmolVLM2-2.2B reach 0.958 and 0.9

translated_title: 视觉-语言安全表示中的单模态捷径与场景-意图联合依赖
translated_abstract: 向视觉-语言模型发出的请求是否安全往往取决于图像：询问如何上菜，对于新鲜食物是无害的，而对于变质食物则是有害的。在情境安全基准上取得的高准确率并不能告诉我们模型的安全表示是否同时编码了场景和用户意图，因为基准测试往往可以仅凭单一模态就能解决。我们研究了冻结的视觉-语言安全表示，审计了五个公开的情境基准，发现每个基准都存在单模态捷径：仅凭图像就能预测标签，而且在相同图像的提示对上，一个从未看过照片的探针就能达到0.9645的AUROC。因此，我们构建了一个受控评估，将安全与危险场景同观察类和行动类请求进行交叉组合，使得任何单模态规则都无法超过0.500的组排序准确率。在这一控制集上，作用于Qwen3-VL-8B和SmolVLM2-2.2B中间状态的线性探针分别达到了0.958和0.9…（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该研究审计发现现有情境安全基准均存在单模态捷径（仅凭图像即可高精度预测安全标签），并构建了一个将场景与意图交叉、排除单模态规则的受控评估，从而证明冻结视觉-语言模型的安全表示确实联合编码了场景与用户意图。
en_tdlr: This work reveals that existing situational safety benchmarks admit unimodal shortcuts and introduces a controlled evaluation crossing scenes with intents, demonstrating that frozen vision-language models' safety representations jointly encode both the scene and the user's intent.
